observations.meaning: Tomographically reconstructed coronal electron density on the archive spherical grid of Carrington longitude, Carrington latitude, and heliocentric radius.
limitations: This is a reconstruction from a series of COR1-A polarized-brightness observations, not one instantaneous exposure.
TIMESYS is absent, so FITS 4.0 requires the DATE-BEG, DATE-AVG and DATE-END values to be interpreted as UTC.
The COR1A archive path and release README identify COR1-A while the FITS OBSRVTRY card says STEREO_B; that contradictory card is retained as a limitation rather than used as telescope identity.
F16 classification establishes source-declared physical spherical coordinates and electron-density units; it does not independently validate the tomography.
